plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Markt Commerce uses your location to fill in your delivery or shop address and to show sellers and products near you. For example, tapping "Use my current location" at checkout sets your delivery address to where you are.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: Markt Commerce does not use motion or fitness data. This description is required because the location library the app uses to find your address includes motion support, but the app never requests it.

plugins.cameraPermission: Markt Commerce uses your camera so you can take photos to share in the app. For example, photographing a product to list it for sale or sending a picture to a seller in chat.

plugins.photosPermission: Markt Commerce uses your photo library so you can choose pictures to share in the app. For example, adding product photos to a listing, setting your profile picture, or sending an image in chat.
